# Lossless Context for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

A **hierarchical context-compaction and retrieval backend** for DSH. Keep the native session history intact while building traceable summary nodes and allowing agents to retrieve their original supporting text.

## Features

- Uses the native DSH compaction transaction; the plugin does **not** replace or delete source session logs.
- Summarizes bounded, tool-call-safe event groups into a layered source DAG.
- Exposes one session-local model tool, `lcm_recall`, with `action: 'search'` (default), `action: 'describe'` (summary DAG), and `action: 'expand'` (raw source by sequence, DAG node, or query).
- Adapts headroom, target summary length and output budgets to the **actual selected model**; model failures, timeouts and truncated summaries are handled with bounded attempts and safe commit rules.
- Can prepare reusable summary leaves during idle maintenance without committing compaction.
- Optionally rotates eligible owner-verified Discord/Feishu direct-message sessions after a verified [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) handoff; recent rotation failures are backed off rather than retried every idle turn.

## Task-end compaction and retained history

The default leaf **source input** chunk is **24,000 tokens** (not the completion cap). Successful, complete leaf and condensed summaries are cached in the derived local SQLite index for up to 7 days, capped at 128 per session / 512 globally and 128 KiB each. A failed multi-stage compaction never publishes an incomplete checkpoint; next retry or restart reuses fragments only when source content, model and summary settings match. The default per-request summarizer timeout is 240 seconds to allow slower valid merged summaries.


Normal pressure threshold checks now schedule **idle compaction after a completed turn**, while active turns only compact for imminent pressure or provider-confirmed context overflow. Both modes use the same `retainRatio` / `retainTokens` budget (including model-specific policies); a threshold such as 0.5 controls *when*, not how much recent text is retained.

The installed DSH RC.2 `compactNow` safety path did not expose a retained-tail parameter. The bundled MIT-licensed, narrowly adapted native helper adds that argument and otherwise preserves the native idle maintenance, complete tool-pair boundaries, durable transaction, cancellation, and checkpoint flushing. It must be reviewed again when updating DSH; see `native/SOURCE.md`.

A provider can advertise a very high absolute `maxTokens` ceiling. Proactive emergency compaction now uses a bounded output forecast, rather than treating that entire ceiling as the expected next completion. It targets near-window pressure while preserving the native context-overflow recovery path; exceptionally long generations can still exceed the forecast. Idle compaction retries a temporarily busy native maintenance slot up to three times, only while the agent is idle.

Transport errors and truncated summaries use separate bounded retries; timeout and output budgets are independently configurable. A successful unit test does not substitute for a live model compaction test.

## Install and enable

Requires a compatible DSH host with its native session, token-meter and compaction services. See [package.json](package.json) for peer dependencies.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-lossless-context
```

Then open **Settings → Plugins → Lossless Context**, enable the backend, and choose the `dsh-lossless-context/agent` compaction backend for the agent preset that should use it. Installing the settings plugin alone does not guarantee that every preset uses this backend. Restart when changing plugin code or preset composition.

## How it works

```text
Native session events
  → native compaction selection
  → bounded summary leaves → merged summary DAG
  → native commit (only on success)
  → searchable index with references to source event IDs
```

The current session keeps its native record. Retrieval and expansion resolve back to original source events. Model/provider limits and existing policies control thresholds; unavailable model metadata causes a safe error instead of invented budgets.

### Idle preparation

When the deferred timing is enabled, an idle agent may summarise the next compactable segment **before** compaction is needed and keep the result in the summary cache. A later commit then reuses those results instead of calling the model again. The work is bounded: at most two model calls per idle pass, at most three passes per uninterrupted idle period, and it stops as soon as the agent receives a message.

Preparation and commit share the same payload builders (`leafPayload`, `condensedPayload`, `groupLayer`), so a warmed cache entry always matches the key the commit computes. A summary layer that cannot shrink is reported as `lcm-condensed-summary-does-not-fit` and ends the pass instead of retrying the same request.

Diagnostics separate the two sources of cache hits: `warm.completed` reports `cacheHits`/`warmHits` for idle preparation, while `compression.completed` reports `cacheHits`/`modelCalls`/`modelMs` for the commit itself.

## Safety, storage, and tests

The plugin stores **derived indexes** under DSH's data directory, not a second complete conversation history. Invalid, cancelled, oversized or truncated summaries are not committed. Private-channel auto-rotation requires verified owner/workspace bindings and completed Dream evidence; ordinary desktop/group/unverified sessions are not silently moved.

Run `npm test` for portable policy/regression tests. Real compaction and summary quality require an active model and DSH host. Example settings: [config.example.json](config.example.json). Historical notes: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Related: [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) · [Channel Core](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Optional plugin diagnostics

The plugin optionally emits privacy-restricted operation and failure metadata to dsh-plugin-diagnostics. Diagnostics contain event type, status, fixed error code and elapsed time; conversation content and credentials are not logged. The diagnostics plugin is optional and does not change the host requirements.

## Editable compaction guidance

Leaf and merged summaries can include customizable default quality guidance emphasizing project decisions, exact file paths/configuration names, validation evidence, and task state changes. A **Restore default** button resets the setting. Guidance supplements the native compaction protocol: tool pairing, source retention, cancellation and complete-transaction checks are unchanged. Changes to the summary policy invalidate stale reusable leaves.

## Bounded concurrent summarization (0.1.39)

Independent leaf summaries and same-layer merges use `summaryConcurrency` (default 3, range 1–3). Their results are assembled in source order; on failure the plugin stops pending calls and does not publish a partial native compaction. For rate-limited model providers, reduce concurrency to 1–2. After a turn ends below the formal threshold, idle summary preparation can resume for later reuse.

Summary content is XML-escaped. Oversized text retains a bounded head/middle/end preview when externalized, and `lcm_recall` can search the first 512 KiB of each of at most 128 recent session-local files. The native transcript remains intact.

Automated regression tests do not establish real-world model speed or summary fidelity; verify those on real sessions.

Five boundaries, each failing closed.

# dsh-plugin-coding-delegate

**Repo-native cryptographic attestation, anti-self-approval enforcement, and an execution perimeter for
autonomous coding agents.**

Every verified delegation leaves a signed record in the repository's own Git notes, bound to the commit it
describes: the execution receipt and the human approval are two signatures made by two different keys, and
the audit that checks both runs offline. Control mapping for SOC 2 CC8.1, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act:
[docs/enterprise-governance.md](docs/enterprise-governance.md).

Who this is for — the roles that are blocked today, and the obligation each one is trying to discharge:
[Target audience and market positioning](docs/target-audience.md).

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) plugin that separates **who specifies** work
from **who implements** it, and refuses to let the first party write the second party's code. It is a
technical control, not a policy: enforcement happens in a tool-call hook before a write lands, so it does
not depend on the model choosing to comply.

The metered model has no write tool and no shell. A fully prompt-injected architect can plan anything and
still cannot change a byte of your host, because the permission is never granted.

## The two guarantees this control exists to make

Two properties, both of the kind a pipeline usually asserts rather than enforces. Everything else in this
README is in service of them.

### 1. Anti-self-approval: two principals, two keys, checked

A record under attestation spec **1.2** carries a `worker` receipt and a `reviewer` approval, with three
signatures sealed in order: the worker signature over the payload, the reviewer signature over the payload
*including* the frozen worker block, and the outer envelope seal last, because adding the reviewer block
would invalidate an earlier seal.

* **The two keys must differ.** Equal fingerprints are refused with `self-approval refused`. Red-team probe
  10 signs a reviewer block with the worker's own key; without that check the record verifies perfectly.
* **The record must name the key that verifies it.** A genuine signature from a key the record names but the
  resolved trust root does not know is refused (probe 9).
* **Approval is a separate, human, two-phase act.** `--prepare <target> <contract>` runs the contract and
  stages an untracked draft that cannot be committed; `--approve <target> --reviewer-identity "<name>"`
  re-verifies the draft against the anchored tree, adds the reviewer block, attaches once, reads the note
  back byte-identical, and only then removes the draft. It does **not** re-run the contract: the record must
  carry what phase one saw, not a second opinion collected later.
* **No plugin path can author a human claim.** `delegate_worker` settles execution status only — the four
  registry outcomes `UNIT_PASSED`, `UNIT_FAILED`, `UNIT_UNVERIFIED` and `UNIT_FLAKY`, which are verdicts and
  not signing keys. The three tool parameters that once let a caller name a reviewing human are gone, and a
  compile-time assertion keeps them gone.

**Residual boundary.** With the in-repo reviewer key in use, a committer who can edit both
`keys/delegation-reviewer.pub` and the operator pin could substitute both roots. Pin the reviewer root out of
band with `DSH_REVIEWER_PUBKEY` or `DSH_REVIEWER_FINGERPRINT`, and a second signature becomes evidence about
a principal the record's author cannot reach. Details:
[dual attestation](#dual-attestation-the-worker-receipt-and-the-human-reviewer-spec-12).

### 2. Repo-native provenance: the record cannot outrun its commit

Attestations are Ed25519-signed notes in `refs/notes/delegations` — objects in the same database as the
code, so they clone and verify offline. Every claim in a record is re-derived at audit time from the
**anchored commit's tree**, never from the working copy: a note that names one commit and lives on another,
whose anchor is not an ancestor of `main`, or whose artifact or contract digest does not match the blob at
that commit is refused. The full check list is under
[Cryptographic Provenance & Attestation Model](#cryptographic-provenance--attestation-model), and is
specified in full in [docs/enterprise-governance.md](docs/enterprise-governance.md) §3.

**Residual boundary.** A Git ref is not write-once storage: notes can be edited, re-attached or removed, and
the ref can be force-pushed. The audit catches every mutation that leaves a record behind — the red-team
harness performs ten of them — and it refuses an empty ledger, but it cannot detect one note removed while
others remain. That needs an external sink, and the auditor says so in its own closing line.

## Auditing it yourself

Run these from a clone. The published npm package is the plugin (`plugin/dist`); the gate and signing tooling
deliberately live in the checkout rather than in the tarball, so there is no standalone CLI to install and no
extra artefact to trust:

```bash
npm run gate                                 # all seven commands (eight tools), offline
node scripts/verify-delegation-ledger.cjs    # the ledger audit alone
node scripts/redteam-probe.cjs               # ten attack classes; restores the ledger afterwards
```

A green run prints `AUDIT PASSED`, then the one limit that matters: *"this proves the records present are
sound. It cannot detect a record that was deleted."* To check a **published** release against its tag — this
one needs the network — run
`powershell -File scripts/verify-release-tarball.ps1 -Version <version> -Tag v<version>`, substituting the
release you are checking; it compares the tarball and the tag in both directions by Git blob hash.

The same gate runs on every push in [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml), with
`fetch-depth: 0` and an explicit `refs/notes/delegations` fetch, because a depth-1 checkout would audit an
empty ledger and report success. The `v0.5.7` release commit was gated by
[run 210](https://github.com/jjmlovesgit/dsh-plugin-coding-delegate/actions/runs/38932268538), which concluded
`success`. A CI workflow holds no signing key, so the signer lifecycle step reports a named `# SKIP` there
rather than passing silently.

## Getting Started

`dsh-plugin-coding-delegate` puts an enforcement boundary between an architect model and an untrusted
worker: it intercepts the handoff, keeps the worker from seeing the tests that judge it, sandboxes the
verification run, and can sign a cryptographic note per unit.

### Prerequisites

- **Node.js 22 or later** — the verification sandbox uses `--permission`, which older releases do not have.
- **A DSH profile you actually boot** (`web`, `tauri`, `headless`, or your own), with an architect model
  and a reachable worker endpoint (local LM Studio at `127.0.0.1:1234`, or a cloud worker you choose).
- Optional: an Ed25519 private key at `attestationPrivateKeyPath` if you want the unit signed. Without one
  the verdict is still produced and the attestation is **withheld**, not faked.

### Step 1 — install into a profile, not into the repository

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-coding-delegate
```

DSH does not read a `plugins` array from a config file. A profile is a directory at
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>` with its own `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`, and `dsh plugin` forwards
to `pnpm` inside it. `npm install` in your project does **not** mount the tool.

### Step 2 — confirm registration

The plugin ships a patch that inserts one entry; DSH applies it when the bundle is loaded. On startup:

```
[LOCAL_ROUTER_INIT] Tool 'delegate_worker' registered successfully on ctx.tools.
```

If you do not see that line, the active profile is not loading the plugin — check which profile the
process booted, not the project you are standing in.

### Step 3 — write a verification contract

A contract is the oracle for one unit. It must be a standalone script:

```js
// tests/contract-add.cjs — .cjs, because the default package type is CommonJS
const assert = require('node:assert');
const { add } = require('../src/add.js');

try {
  assert.strictEqual(add(2, 3), 5, '2 + 3 must equal 5');
  assert.strictEqual(add

# dsh-pleading-draft — Pleading element checklist completeness check, one row per claim

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-pleading-draft?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-pleading-draft?ref=badge)

`dsh-pleading-draft` reads one pleading-element checklist — the case header plus one row per claim, with its `序号`、`诉讼请求`、`事实依据`、`证据`、`法律依据`、`金额`、`期限` columns — and checks that document's own completeness and internal consistency: that every claim records a factual basis, points at evidence and states a legal basis, that a claim carrying an amount also carries a performance deadline, that the header names the plaintiff and the defendant, that no element number is repeated, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the claim column.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-pleading-draft
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-pleading-draft'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-pleading-draft: call → plugin → result.](docs/assets/dsh-pleading-draft-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: call → plugin → result. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `pleading_draft`

**Input**

~~~json
{"caseNo":"（2026）某民初 1234 号","rows":[{"序号":"1","请求要素":"本金给付请求","诉讼请求":"判令被告支付货款本金人民币 1,250,000 元","事实依据":"","证据":"证1、证2、证3"}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-pleading-draft.PL-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "PL-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1,
    "field": "fact"
  },
  "found": "第 1 行「fact」为空",
  "expected": "「fact」应填写",
  "fix": "补填事实依据；本条只核对是否写明，不判断事实是否属实"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-pleading-draft/tests/fixtures/PL-001/PL-001-unsafe.json (cases.json expects 1×PL-001); executed parseMaterial+runCheck, checkedAt=2026-10-06T00:00:00.000Z`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The claim is written out, but the evidence column points at nothing. | `PL-002` reports the row whose `证据` column does not point at evidence — it checks that a reference is written, not that the evidence exists, is complete or bears on that particular claim. |
| The legal-basis column holds only a general phrase such as “relevant provisions”. | `PL-003` requires the `法律依据` column to be filled on every claim element. It reports an empty column; it does not verify that the provision cited exists, is in force or applies to the case. |
| The amount is stated, but no performance deadline is recorded. | `PL-004` fires only when the `金额` column is filled, and then requires the `期限` column: an amount without a deadline is reported. A claim for a declaration is not asked for a deadline it does not have. Whether the amount is computed correctly or the deadline is reasonable is not checked. |
| Which fields must the case header carry? | `PL-005` requires the header to name the plaintiff and the defendant; both are configuration fields, so your own form can add the cause of action and the accepting court. It does not check that the parties are the right ones for that claim. |
| What happens when the claim column still holds a template placeholder? | `PL-007` reports it: the terms it looks for are `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo` and `示例`. A vague claim with none of those terms passes, because judging the required precision of a claim is a legal judgement. |
| A rule appears in `skipped` instead of reporting anything. Does that mean it passed? | No. `skipped` names a check that did not run: `PL-002`, for instance, is listed there when it was disabled in configuration, left out by the `only` selection, or when the material met its precondition and no difference was found. A check that does not run cannot clear a column, and its own limit stands: it never sees whether the evidence suffices or corresponds to the claim. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》 | 1991年通过，经 2007、2012、2017、2021、2023 年五次修正（现行条号据 2021 年第四次修正及 2023 年第五次修正文本核对） | PL-001, PL-002, PL-003, PL-004, PL-005, PL-006, PL-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **起诉状（或申请书）要素核对表** for completeness — that every claim records
its factual basis, points at evidence, states its legal basis, that a monetary claim states an amount and a
performance deadline, that the document names both parties, that element numbers are unique, and that no
placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether a claim will succeed, whether it is time-barred, whether
jurisdiction is right, whether the evidence suffices, or whether the case should be accepted. **Those are the
court's determinations and the advocate's substantive judgement.**

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin can and cannot do
>
> **It reads a checklist, not the pleadings, the evidence or the statutes.** So it can only check that a
> column *points at* evidence or *names* a provision — **never that the evidence suffices or that the
> provision exists, is in force, or applies**. `PL-002` and `PL-003` say so in their own notes. Test the
> plugin against a pleading whose cited article was repealed: it will pass, because looking up statutes is a
> different job and one this plugin deliberately does not do.
>
> **The rule pack states its citation status rule by rule.** **4 of its 7 rules quote verbatim clause text** and are marked `direct`; the remaining 3 state in the `excerpt` field itself that the text was not obtained, and stay at `warn` or `info`. Where a rule still carries that note, treat it as a lead rather than as a citation. The
> regime lives in 《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》(notably its article on what a statement of claim must record)
> and the Supreme People's Court's interpretation of it. For the rules whose text the verification pass could not retrieve, the pack states the gap in the
> `excerpt` field itself rather than paraphrasing it, and those rules stay at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and raise `kind` to
> `direct`.**
>
> `PL-004` fires only when an amount column is filled, so a claim for a declaration or for a change of legal
> relation is not asked for a performance deadline it does not have. And `PL-007` catches placeholders only:
> a claim that is vague **without** containing `【】` or `待填` will pass, because judging whether a claim is
> stated with the required precision is a legal judgement.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for several claims use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `pleading_draft` tool. It reads one pleading-element checklist — the case header plus one row per
claim — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PL-001` | every claim records its factual basis | warn | direct |
| `PL-002` | every claim points at evidence | warn | direct |
| `PL-003` | every claim states its legal basis | warn | direct |
| `PL-004` | a monetary claim states amount and deadline | warn | principle |
| `PL-005` | the document names plaintiff and defendant | warn | direct |
| `PL-006` | element numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `PL-007` | the claim column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/pleading-draft.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop runn

# dsh-power-ticket-check — Power work-ticket completeness and issue-permit-termination order check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-power-ticket-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-power-ticket-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-power-ticket-check` reads one **电力工作票** as a flat mapping of the ticket's own column names to their values, together with the roles named on it, and checks that ticket for what a form can be held to: that every column in your configured `requiredFields` is filled, that the 工作票种类 is one your deployment lists, that 签发时间 → 许可时间 → 终结时间 form a sequence that is physically possible, that a 延期时间 pushes the end forward and does not precede the permit, that roles you configured as exclusive are held by different people, and that the safety-measure and permit text carries the five 安全技术措施 terms and the three 许可手续 terms the pack looks for. Checks that could not run are listed in `skipped` with their reason rather than passing silently.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-power-ticket-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-power-ticket-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-power-ticket-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-power-ticket-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `power_ticket_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"工作票编号":"DL-2026-0001","工作票种类":"电气第一种工作票","安全措施":"应停电、验电、装设接地线。"}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-power-ticket-check.PT-006.104aebcf",
  "ruleId": "PT-006",
  "severity": "error",
  "locator": {
    "column": "安全措施"
  },
  "found": "安全措施文本中未出现 2 项：悬挂标示牌、装设遮栏",
  "expected": "在电气设备上工作，应有停电、验电、装设接地线、悬挂标示牌和装设遮栏（围栏）等保证安全的技术措施",
  "fix": "核对票面是否写全五项；本条只核对是否写到，不判断措施内容是否与现场相符"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-power-ticket-check/tests/fixtures/PT-006/PT-006-unsafe.json (cases.json expects 1×PT-006); executed parseMaterial+runCheck, checkedAt=2026-10-06T00:00:00.000Z`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| Out of the box it passes every ticket I run through it — why? | Because `PT-001` reports itself in `skipped`, not as a pass. Its `requiredFields` list ships empty, so the rule cannot run; fill it with the columns your own form requires. Even when configured, `PT-001` checks that a column is filled, not that the value in it is correct, and it sits at `info`. |
| The ticket is a 电气第一种工作票 but the 工作性质 mentions 带电作业 — is that a contradiction it reports? | No. `PT-002` reports only two things: that the 工作票种类 is missing, or that it is not among the kinds your deployment lists. Its `ticketKinds` list ships empty and the rule then reports itself in `skipped`, exactly as `PT-005` does when its `exclusiveRolePairs` list is empty; the plugin does not decide which kind of ticket a job needs. Once you fill those lists, configure `PT-005` with the pair 工作许可人 and 工作负责人 to have the same person in both columns reported. Neither rule judges anyone's qualification or whether holding two roles was approved. |
| The 许可时间 is written earlier than the 签发时间, and one time column will not parse. | `PT-003` reports both: 许可时间 earlier than 签发时间, 终结时间 earlier than 许可时间, and any unreadable column as 无法解析为日期时间, expecting a form such as `2026-03-15 08:30`. Both ends are converted to an absolute minute count, so a ticket spanning midnight compares correctly. If 签发时间 or 许可时间 cannot be read at all, the rule reports itself in `skipped`, because the order check cannot be established. It never checks whether the work actually followed the ticket, and an optional interval or duration limit is yours to configure. |
| The 延期时间 is earlier than the 计划结束时间, so the extension shortens the job rather than lengthening it. | `PT-004` reports it, and also reports a 延期时间 earlier than the 许可时间. The standard sets no ceiling on how long or how often a ticket may be extended, so the rule carries no quantitative limit and does not check whether the extension formalities were completed. |
| The 安全措施 column is filled in but mentions only 停电 and 验电. | `PT-006` reports the three missing terms one by one. It is the only rule here at `error`, because its clause 6.1.1 sits in the mandatory chapter, and it checks that the five measures are written on the ticket, not that they match the site or were carried out. If no readable measure column is found it reports itself in `skipped`. |
| Nothing on the ticket shows that the 工作许可人 went to the site again with the 工作负责人. | `PT-007` reports which of the three permit-formality terms are absent from the text it reads, that text being the `permitColumns` plus the names in the role columns. It reads wording only: it cannot tell whether the site re-check really happened, and an institution that wants this to block can raise the rule's severity in the pack without a code change. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《电力安全工作规程 发电厂和变电站电气部分》 | GB 26860—2011 | PT-001, PT-002, PT-003, PT-004, PT-005, PT-006, PT-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks one **电力工作票** for what a form can be held to — that the required
boxes are filled, that 签发 / 许可 / 终结 happened in an order that is physically possible, that 延期
moves the end forward, and that roles you require to be separate are held by different people. It does
**not** judge whether the safety measures written on the ticket were adequate, **does not** say which
kind of ticket a job needs, and **does not** verify that anyone's qualification is real.

> ### ⚠️ Three things this plugin refuses to do, and the effect tier that fixes its severities
>
> **1. It respects the standard's own effect tier.** GB 26860—2011's foreword says, verbatim,
> 「本标准的第5章和7.3.4为推荐性，其余为强制性」 — **the work-ticket regime sits in the *recommendatory*
> chapter 5.** So every rule resting on chapter 5 ships at `warn` or `info` and **nothing there can block a
> workflow**. `PT-006` (the five safety technical measures, clause 6.1.1) is the **only** `error`, because
> chapter 6 is mandatory. `PT-007` (the permit formalities, clause 5.5.1) is a `warn`; its note explains that
> an institution which wants those formalities to block can raise it by editing the rule pack, with no code
> change. A test asserts both directions: no chapter-5 rule is an `error`, and `PT-006` is the sole one.
>
> **2. It does not adopt three claims that have no basis in the standards.** After reading GB 26860—2011
> and GB 26859—2011 in full: there is **no** "第一种工作票应工作前一日送达" deadline anywhere; 5.3.12 and
> 5.4.10 say only 「延期应办理手续」 with **no ceiling on duration or count**; and the statutory name is
> **紧急抢修单** (5.2.4), not "事故应急抢修单". A test asserts the pack records all three.
>
> **3. It does not treat the ticket layout as mandatory.** 5.1.2 says the ticket "**可**包含" those items,
> and appendices A–D are marked **资料性附录** (informative) in the standard's contents. So `PT-001` ships
> with an **empty** field list for you to fill from your own form, and reports at `info`.
>
> Two more lists are yours: `PT-002`'s ticket kinds and `PT-005`'s exclusive role pairs. Both ship empty.
> The plugin never judges whether the safety measures written on a ticket were adequate, which ticket
> kind a job needs, or whether anyone's qualification is real — the standard sets out roles' **duties**
> (5.4.1–5.4.5) and **no qualification conditions**.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no mode

# dsh-plugin-code-quality

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that adds two code-quality commands to the `/` menu:

| Command | What it does | Who can invoke it |
|---|---|---|
| `/simplify [target]` | Applies behavior-preserving cleanups to the code you changed — reuses helpers that already exist, removes needless complexity, cuts wasted work, and re-seats changes made at the wrong layer. Not a bug hunt. | you **and** the model |
| `/code-review [level] [--fix] [target]` | Hunts for real correctness defects in the current diff with several independent review angles, verifies every candidate before reporting it, and ranks what survives most-severe first. | you only |
| `/review …` | Alias of `/code-review`. Same behavior, same instructions. | you only |

Both commands follow the design that mainstream code review tooling has converged on, adapted to DeepSeek Harness's tools, instruction-file layout and subagent model.

---

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @hope_phenom/dsh-plugin-code-quality
```

Then restart the profile (or let HMR pick it up) and type `/` in the composer — `simplify`, `code-review` and `review` appear under the skills group.

For local development against a checkout:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add F:\path\to\dsh-plugin-code-quality
```

### Upgrading

`add` records a caret range, and pnpm keeps whatever exact version is already in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so
running the install command again with the bare package name will **not** move you to a newer release. Name
the version explicitly, or remove the plugin and add it again:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @hope_phenom/dsh-plugin-code-quality@0.1.1
```

Then fully restart the profile. Replacing a package that is already loaded needs a new module generation —
HMR only covers bundles that were not loaded before.

Behind a registry mirror the mirror itself can lag a release by minutes to hours, and pnpm's local metadata
cache outlives that lag. When the version you asked for cannot be found, pass the upstream registry:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @hope_phenom/dsh-plugin-code-quality@0.1.1 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

### Requirements

- DSH with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skill` composed. Both are part of the shipped standard preset, so a stock install already has them.
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- The plugin has **no dependencies and no peer dependencies** — it imports nothing from DSH and talks to the host only through the `ctx` object it is handed.

---

## Usage

### `/simplify`

```text
/simplify                       # clean up everything changed since the upstream branch
/simplify src/parser.ts         # restrict the review to one path
/simplify 421                   # review a pull request instead of the local diff
```

Scope resolution, in order: a target you named, then `git diff '@{upstream}...HEAD'`, then `main...HEAD` (falling back to `origin/main`, `master`), then `HEAD~1`. Working-tree edits and untracked files are folded in, because the command is most useful *before* you commit. If nothing changed, it says so and stops.

Four independent reviewers look at the diff — **Reuse**, **Simplification**, **Efficiency** and **Altitude**. A finding only counts if it names the concrete replacement: the existing helper to call, the simpler form, the cheaper alternative, or the general mechanism the special case should fold into. Findings that cannot fill that slot are dropped before they reach you.

Surviving findings are deduplicated and applied directly. Anything whose fix would change intended behavior, or that needs work outside the diff, is skipped and reported as skipped rather than argued about.

### `/code-review`

```text
/code-review                    # balanced review at the default level
/code-review high               # more angles, higher findings cap, recall-biased verification
/code-review max --fix          # widest sweep, then apply the findings
/code-review high src/parser.ts # level plus a target
```

The level word is read out of your own message — there is no argument parser, because the command is delivered as instructions.

| Level | Correctness angles | Cleanup angles | Candidates per finder | Report cap | Verification bias |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `low` | 3 | 0 | 4 | 5 | drop anything not `CONFIRMED` |
| `medium` *(default)* | 5 | 2 | 6 | 8 | balanced |
| `high` | 6 | 4 | 8 | 12 | keep `PLAUSIBLE` |
| `max` | 6 | 4 + sweep | 8 | 20 | keep `PLAUSIBLE` |

Six correctness angles are defined, and the level decides how many run — three at `low`, five at `medium`, all six at `high` and `max`:

| id | angle | the question it asks |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | line-by-line hunk scan | What input, state, timing or platform makes each changed line produce the wrong result — including unchanged lines of a touched function. |
| C2 | removed-behavior audit | What invariant did each deleted or replaced line enforce, and where does the new code re-establish it? |
| C3 | cross-file contract tracing | Does the change break a caller through a new precondition, return shape, throwing path or ordering requirement? |
| C4 | language and framework pitfalls | Which classic trap of the languages actually present in this diff is being stepped in? |
| C5 | async, concurrency and resource lifetime | Races, missing `await`, abandoned work, error paths that skip cleanup, listeners that outlive their owner. |
| C6 | error paths and boundaries | Empty collections, zero and negative values, null, multi-byte text, overflow, timeouts, partial writes, oversized payloads. |

Every candidate then goes to a **separate verifier** that is told to try to *refute* it and must answer `CONFIRMED`, `PLAUSIBLE` or `REFUTED`. At `high` and `max`, a final sweep reviewer sees the verified list and looks only for gaps. When the report cap forces a cut, correctness findings outrank cleanup, altitude and conventions findings.

Output is one line per finding:

```text
src/parser.ts:118 — the retry loop resets `attempts` inside the loop; a persistent 503 retries forever
```

If nothing survives verification it says so in one line instead of padding the report. `--fix` applies the surviving findings after reporting them; without it the command never edits a file.

---

## How it works

The plugin has no client half, no tools, no services and no HTTP routes. `lib/index.js` does exactly one thing:

```js
export const name = 'dsh-plugin-code-quality'
export const inject = ['skills']

export function apply(ctx) {
  for (const skill of SKILLS) ctx.skills.register(skill)
}
```

### Why skills instead of `ctx.commands`

DSH gives a plugin two ways to add a `/` command, and they are not equivalent:

- **`ctx.commands.register()`** publishes a *host command*. Its handler runs against the agent directly and, by default, produces no model message — a command that wants to make the model work has to submit a synthetic user message itself.
- **`ctx.skills.register()` with `userInvocable: true`** publishes a *skill*. The composer sends your message verbatim, `/simplify` token included, and the host appends the skill body as a `<skill_content>` instruction block at the pre-step boundary.

The second is exactly the substrate these two commands need: their entire content *is* an instruction document, your typed target text arrives intact, and there is no synthetic message pretending to be you.

### Invocation policy

`simplify` is registered with `{ modelInvocable: true, userInvocable: true }`, so the model also sees it in its skill catalog and can reach for it on its own — a behavior-preserving cleanup pass is a reasonable thing for an agent to decide it needs.

`code-review` and `review` are registered with `{ modelInvocable: false, userInvocable: true }`. They never enter the model's catalog and cannot be self-invoked; the `/` menu is their only entry point, where DSH marks them as user-only.

### `/review` is a second registration, not a pointer

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` keys a runtime registration by `name` alone — there is no alias field (DSH's loca

# dsh-balance-peek

在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部，用两行极简文字显示 **DeepSeek 余额** 和 **当前峰谷时段**。

```
余额                    ¥5.43
空闲              2h14m 后转峰
```

- **极简**：纯文字，没有图标、没有图表、没有动画。宽栏两行；收起成 56px 窄栏时退化为「¥5.43 / 谷」两格。
- **只读余额**：数字来自官方 `GET /user/balance`，与 DeepSeek 后台「充值余额」一致。
- **零配置**：直接复用 DSH 已保存的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`；没配 key 时退回已登录的 DeepSeek 账号钱包。
- **实时**：余额每分钟自动刷新（Host 侧另有 25 秒缓存）；峰/谷状态与倒计时由浏览器本地时钟每秒计算，不产生任何额外请求。
- **点击展开**：点这两行会强制刷新余额，并展开明细（当前时段、余额更新时间、数字来源）。

> **为什么没有当日花费**：2.0.0 起移除了该功能。要算准「今日」必须回放当天全部会话日志（一天往往在 DSH 启动之前就开始了），而且**仍然统计不到在 DSH 之外用同一把 key 发起的调用**——数字天生偏低且容易被误读。余额是官方口径、绝对可靠，所以这个插件只报余额。想看花费请用 [dsh-cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) 或 DeepSeek 后台的用量页。

## 安装

```sh
# 从 npm 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-balance-peek

# 从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:QWHYQ114514-cell/dsh-balance-peek

# 从本地目录安装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-balance-peek
```

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-balance-peek.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-balance-peek) 当前版本 `2.0.0`

把 `desktop` 换成你自己的 profile 名（Web 版通常是 `web`）。装好后刷新页面即可看到。

> **只加依赖是不够的。** DSH 通过 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 决定挂载哪些插件；本包在 `package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以只要它在 bundles 列表里就会被挂载。`dsh plugin add` 会自动把它加进去；如果你手工编辑过 `package.json`，请确认列表里有 `dsh-balance-peek`。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-balance-peek
```

## 峰谷规则

按 DeepSeek 官方定价页（[模型 & 价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)）：

| 时段 | 判定 |
| --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 北京时间**周一至周五**（不含中国法定节假日）**9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00** |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时段，含**周末**、**调休上班的周末**、**法定节假日全天** |

高峰单价 = 空闲单价 × 2。插件只显示当前处于哪个时段以及距离切换还有多久，不参与计价。

> ⚠️ **年度维护**：法定节假日清单写在 `lib/index.js` 与 `lib/client.js` 的 `HOLIDAY_VALLEY` 常量里，目前覆盖 **2026 年**。国务院每年 11 月发布次年安排后需要补录，否则次年的法定节假日会被当成普通工作日显示（只影响显示）。

## 数据来源

- **余额**：调用官方 `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，凭据来自 DSH 的 `credentials` 服务；取不到 key 时退回 `deepseekAccount.getBalance()`（登录账号的钱包）。展开明细里的「来源」会写明这次用的是哪一种。
- **不落盘**：插件不写任何文件、不留账本，重启无状态。
- 余额是**总额**（充值 + 赠送钱包合计，取接口返回的 `balance_infos[0]`）。如果你的账号同时有赠送额度，这个数与后台单看的「充值余额」可能有差别。

## 结构

```
dsh-balance-peek/
├─ package.json         声明 dsh.bundle.patch 与 dsh.client
├─ cordis.patch.yml     把插件插入 profile 的加载树
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js          Host 半区：取余额、暴露只读路由（约 280 行）
│  └─ client.js         浏览器半区：注册到 sidebar.footer.action 的 React 组件
└─ _tools/              离线验证脚本（不进 npm 包）
```

`lib/client.js` 是**手写的** `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 注册行 —— 这正是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 在 `/plugins` 上提供的、由外壳惰性加载的唯一入口形态。`factory` 内的 `require` 走外壳的平台模块表，React 由页面本身提供，因此**本插件没有任何构建步骤**，两个半区都是可直接阅读的源码。

Host 半区暴露一个只读接口：

```
GET /dsh-balance/state.json[?refresh=1]
```

## 兼容性

| 依赖 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | 开发与验证于 `0.2.0-rc.2`（桌面 profile）。用到的服务是 `credentials` / `deepseekAccount` / `webServer`，插槽是 `sidebar.footer.action`。 |
| 浏览器半区 | 走 `dsh.client` 客户端模块体系：`platform: web` |
| Node | ≥ 20（只用全局 `fetch` 与 `node:os`） |

## 安全说明

- 只读接口，**没有**任何写入能力或设置项，也不写任何文件。
- API key 只在 Host 进程内用于请求官方接口，**从不下发到浏览器**；发出去的数据只有余额数字和时段状态。
- 请求经过三层校验：回环/同源自检，然后委托 DSH 自己的 `connection.requestRejection`（含浏览器会话鉴权）。栅栏缺失时自检仍然生效，不会静默放行。确需从别的 Host 名访问（反代/局域网），设 `DSH_BALANCE_TRUSTED_HOSTS`（逗号分隔 `host:port`）。

## 排查

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧边栏底部什么都没有 | 包名没进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`（只 add 依赖不算挂载）。补上后刷新页面。 |
| 显示 `未配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY…` | 该 key 不在 DSH 凭据里，且当前未登录 DeepSeek 账号。到「设置 → 模型」配置 API Key。 |
| 余额是 `—` | 接口请求失败，展开明细能看到具体错误（HTTP 状态、超时等）。 |
| 数字不刷新 | 插件每分钟轮询一次；点一下那两行可强制刷新。 |
| 与后台「充值余额」对不上 | 接口返回的是总额（含赠送钱包）。展开明细看「来源」，可用 `?refresh=1` 强制取最新值。 |

## 开发

没有构建步骤：直接改 `lib/` 下的两个文件，然后刷新页面（客户端半区由 HMR 重新发布）。

仓库自带离线验证脚本（在 `_tools/` 中），不依赖浏览器：

```sh
node _tools/verify-balance-host.mjs     # 数据链路 + 峰谷/节假日/切换点断言
node _tools/verify-balance-client.mjs   # 插槽注册契约与两行结构
node _tools/audit-client-quotes.mjs     # 手写客户端的引号配平与可解析性
```

`verify-balance-host.mjs` 在设有 `DSH_BALANCE_VERIFY_KEY` 时会真的请求一次官方接口（用来验证凭据链路），未设时只验证降级路径。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Bring DSH back to the foreground when a real-device control turn ends (Android / Shizuku).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-return-front

**真机控制任务结束后，自动把 DSH 切回前台。**

> 适用：**Android 上的 DSH**（Termux 系运行时 + Shizuku 特权通道）。
> 其他平台装上无害——插件会正常加载，但不会做任何事。

---

## 它解决什么问题

在 Android 上用 DSH 驱动真机（点按、开 App、滑动）时，**被操作的那个 App 会占据前台**，DSH 退到后台。于是每跑完一个任务，你都要手动切回 DSH 才能看结果、发下一句。

装上这个插件后：

| | 之前 | 之后 |
|---|---|---|
| 让 agent 在真机上点开某 App | 任务结束，**你手动切回 DSH** | 任务结束，**DSH 自己回到前台** |
| 纯只读任务（截图 / dump） | 前台没变 | **不触发**（本来就没变） |
| 虚拟屏任务 | 不影响真机前台 | **不触发** |

触发条件被刻意收窄，只在"本回合**真的动过真机前台**"且"你开着开关"时才动作。

## 前提条件

1. **DSH 跑在 Android 上**（Termux 系运行时，这决定了宿主 App 的包名可被自动探测）
2. **Shizuku 特权通道就绪**（插件通过它执行拉起命令）
3. **屏幕范围含真机**：`scope` 为 `all` 或 `real-only`
   - 出厂默认是 `virtual-only`。该模式下 agent 本来就动不了真机前台，**所以插件什么都不做**（这是对的，不是 bug）
4. 能执行特权 shell 的运行档位（如 `danger-full-access`）

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zxyan99/dsh-return-front
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后刷新页面。

手工安装（等价，适合本地源码）：

1. 把本仓库放到任意目录
2. 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` 下建一个指向它的软链：
   ```sh
   ln -s /path/to/dsh-return-front "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-return-front"
   ```
3. 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：
   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-return-front
         name: dsh-return-front
   ```
4. 重启 DSH

> 装配顺序需**晚于** `@dsh-android/dsh-android-bridge`（因为要用它提供的特权服务）。放在 patch 末尾通常就满足。

## 使用

**设置 → 通用**，会看到一行：

> **任务收尾**
> ☑ 真机控制任务结束后回到 DSH

勾选/取消即时生效并持久化（存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-return-front.json`）。默认开启。

## 工作原理（简述）

- 订阅 `session/event`，在 `turn/start` 清空状态、在 `tool/call` 记录"本回合是否动过真机前台"、在 `turn/end` 决定是否动作
- **计入**的工具：`android_app_launch`、`android_ui_click`、`android_act_input`、`android_ui_scroll`、`android_ui_input`、`android_ui_global`
- **排除**：全部 `android_vdisplay_*`；全部只读类（`device_info`/`screen_list`/`ui_dump`/`ui_detail`/`ui_tree`/`screenshot`/`web_dump`）
- `screenId` 缺省或 `real` 才算真机；`virtual-N` 不计
- 动作就是一条拉起命令：`monkey -p <宿主包名> -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1`
- 开关通过一条带鉴权的回环路由读写（`/api/dsh-return-front`）

**宿主包名是自动探测的**，取自 Termux 标准环境变量 `TERMUX_APP__DATA_DIR` 的目录名，因此不绑定某个特定的壳应用构建。

## 配置（可选）

在 profile 的 patch 里：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-return-front
      name: dsh-return-front
      config:
        enabled: true           # 初始开关状态（之后以设置页/状态文件为准）
        appPackage: com.example.shell   # 手动指定宿主 App 包名（一般不需要）
        launchCommand: "monkey -p com.example.shell -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1"
```

环境变量覆盖：`DSH_RETURN_FRONT_APP_PACKAGE`。

## 已知边界（诚实清单）

- **只在 Android 上有意义。** 非 Android 宿主上插件会加载但永不动作。
- **`scope=virtual-only` 时不工作**，且这是设计意图：该模式下 agent 动不了真机前台，切回没有意义。插件会静默跳过并写一行 debug 日志，不报错、不刷屏。
- **Shizuku 未运行 / 档位不足**时不报错，只吞掉失败（一行 debug 日志）。
- **只做"切回前台"这一件事**：不改前台内容、不清理、不重启引擎、不碰用户数据。
- 若本回合**动过真机但用户已主动切到别处**，回合结束时仍会被拉回 DSH——这是开关语义的一部分；不想要就关掉。

## 开发

无需构建链，纯手写 bundle（客户端用 `React.createElement` 避开 JSX）。

```sh
node tests/smoke.mjs
```

密闭测试（不接触设备）：覆盖宿主包名自动探测、路由鉴权、持久化、以及触发矩阵（只读不触发 / 真机触发 / 虚拟屏不触发 / 关开关不触发 / 重复 `turn/end` 只触发一次 / 特权通道抛错被吞）。

## 许可

MIT © zxyan99

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Addy-Agent — v1.0.3 bundles

DSH mode **Addy Agent** (`@local/dsh-addy-agent@1.0.3`).
Upstream: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills @ `1be8e34187e34647bb83adc3a1323b26ae6f6abe` (upstream package 0.6.12).
Target DSH runtime: `0.2.1-alpha.2`.

## Contents

- `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-Install/` — install bundle (~1.3 MB, 230 files). Top files + `locale/` + `upstream/` (212 files). Use to install on another machine.
- `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-dev/` — evolve bundle (~22 MB, ~365 files after GitHub prep). Everything in Install PLUS `tests/` + `evidence/` (baselines). Nested `.git/` stripped for GitHub (see below).

## Install on another machine (from r2-Install)

1. Copy `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-Install/` to a permanent path (keep while installed — local installs link it).
2. DSH Plugin Manager → `install_bundle` → absolute directory. No build step.
3. Check activation status. Restart DSH if replacing an imported generation.
4. New session → select **Addy Agent**, working directory = target repo.

Disable: `plugin_manager` → `set_bundle` `@local/dsh-addy-agent` enabled false. Remove: `remove_bundle` same target.

## Evolve / add features (from r2-dev)

1. Edit `adapter-v2.mjs` / `core-v2.mjs` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `duplicate-guard*.mjs` — never edit `upstream/` bytes directly.
2. Verify from dev dir:
   ```powershell
   node --test tests/core.test.mjs
   node tests/contracts-runtime.mjs
   node tests/contracts-config.mjs
   ```
   Compare new `evidence/*.json` vs baselines.
3. Bump upstream: re-clone upstream at new revision into `upstream/`, run `node prepare.mjs` (needs matching DSH runtime + `js-yaml` + git), update docs.
4. Re-install via `install_bundle`, new session → Addy Agent, test `/spec /plan /build /test /ship`.

## GitHub prep notes (already applied here)

- Removed for GitHub push (breaks git submodules, re-creatable):
  - `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-dev/upstream/.git/` (28 files, 2 MB) — revision still pinned in `upstream-manifest.json`
  - `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-dev/tests/live-fixture/.git/` — tiny fixture repo
- Kept: `upstream/LICENSE`, all 212 upstream files, all tests/evidence baselines.
- To rebuild exact upstream bytes: `git clone https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills + git checkout 1be8e34187e34647bb83adc3a1323b26ae6f6abe`.

## Releases

- `v1.0.3-r2` ([release](https://github.com/iona095/DSH_Addy-Agent/releases/tag/v1.0.3-r2)): `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-Install.zip` (install) + `addy-agent-1.0.3.r2-dev.zip` (evolve). Guard generation `r2`.
- Prior `v1.0.3`: `addy-agent-1.0.3-latest.zip` + `addy-agent-1.0.3-dev.zip`.

plugins.description: Favorites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favourites filter for DSH conversations — additive slot extensions over the shipped archive feature, editing no official file. 为 DSH 对话增加收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-favorites-forge

**Favourites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a
favourites filter for DeepSeek Harness conversations** — additive slot
extensions over the shipped archive feature. It edits **no official file**.

**给 DSH 的对话加上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档和收藏筛选 —— 全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方一行代码。**

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-dsh--archive--favorites--forge-cb3837?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archive-favorites-forge)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.2.0--rc.2-4f46e5)](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-archive-favorites-forge)

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

---

## Screenshots

**1. The conversation menu** — favourite, copy id + path, and a guarded permanent delete, added as three rows to the shipped 「…」 menu:

![Session menu](assets/01-session-menu.png)

**2. The favourites filter** — two extra rows in the official 筛选会话 group, narrowing the sidebar to favourites that are archived and to favourites that are not:

![Favourites filter](assets/02-favourites-filter.png)

**3. The settings panel** — idle batch archive, the favourites list with archive state, and batch delete of archived conversations that are not favourites:

![Settings panel](assets/03-settings-panel.png)

---

## Why this exists

DSH already ships an archive feature: the Workspace registry keeps a global
`archivedSessionIds` set and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` renders the
sidebar rows plus a view-options filter. That shipped feature has **no
favourites, no per-conversation delete, no copy-id/path affordance, and no
time-based batch archive** — and it deliberately refuses to open an archived
conversation.

This plugin adds those things by attaching to documented official slot points,
so it composes with the shipped UI instead of patching it.

## Features · At a glance

| | 中文 | English |
|---|---|---|
| ① | **收藏对话**：归档或未归档的对话都能收藏；「…」菜单项 + 行内 ☆，星标即时生效 | **Favourite any conversation** — archived or not; a menu row plus an inline ☆ star, applied optimistically |
| ② | **复制 ID + 路径**：「…」菜单一键复制会话 ID 与转录文件绝对路径（两行） | **Copy id + path** — one menu row copying the session id and the transcript's absolute path |
| ③ | **单条永久删除**：任意非收藏对话可删，二次确认；删完侧栏**立即移除该行** | **Per-conversation permanent delete** — any non-favourite, behind a confirmation, and the sidebar row disappears at once |
| ④ | **超时批量归档**：把闲置超过 N 小时的未归档对话一次性归档，可撤回 | **Idle batch archive** — archives conversations quiet for more than N hours, undoable |
| ⑤ | **导出清单**：制表符分隔的 txt，含**对话名称 / 对话ID / 所属工作区 / 闲置时长 / 最后活动时间**；可复制路径或直接打开所在文件夹 | **Export list** — a tab-separated txt with name, id, workspace, idle time and last-activity time; copy its path or reveal it in the file manager |
| ⑥ | **收藏筛选**：视图选项菜单新增「仅显示收藏（已归档）」与「仅显示收藏（未归档）」 | **Favourites filter** — view-options rows for favourites that are archived, and favourites that are not |
| ⑦ | **批量删除**：一键永久删除「已归档且未收藏」的对话 | **Batch delete** — permanently removes the archived-and-unfavourited conversations |
| ⑧ | **删除护栏**：收藏项拒删、越出会话根目录拒删、符号链接拒删、逐条报告、批量上限 | **Delete guardrails** — favourites refused, paths outside the sessions root refused, symlinks refused, per-id reporting, batch cap |

### Where each feature lives

| Feature | UI location |
|---|---|
| Favourite / copy / delete one conversation | Sidebar row 「…」 menu (and a hover ☆ on the row) |
| Idle batch archive, export list, favourites list, batch delete | **Settings → 归档收藏** |
| Favourites filter | **视图选项 → 筛选会话** |

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-archive-favorites-forge
```

Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**. The host half (`lib/index.js`) has no
watcher in this harness generation, and the client bundle is snapshotted at
startup — so a page refresh alone does **not** pick up a new version.

## How it works

```
lib/index.js    host half   — favourites store, transcript-path resolver,
                              JSON routes, guarded delete, archive/dearchive
lib/client.js   client half — official slot registrations + one DOM rule
```

**Slots used** (all documented in the harness client contract):

| Slot | What it contributes |
|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 3 rows: favourite, copy id+path, delete |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` | 1 hover ☆ star |
| `settings.section` | the 归档收藏 page |

Every contribution is registered through `ctx.slots.inject` — the "register once
the owning entry is mounted" contract — so the plugin never assumes the sidebar
is up, and never holds a reference to a node the host owns.

The favourites filter is the one exception: the view-options menu is a plain
array with **no slot and no trigger id**, so that single control is added by
finding the official filter row in the DOM and cloning it. It keys on
`role`/`aria`/`data-row-key` attributes, never on the CSS-module hashes (which
are re-hashed on every build).

### Why the favourites set lives in a file, not `localStorage`

Renderer `localStorage` is origin-scoped: the desktop shell, a phone view and a
remote browser are different origins and would each keep their own stars. The
host half persists them to

```
~/.dsh/data/dsh-archive-favorites-forge/favorites.json
```

which survives a profile switch, a reinstall, and both ends.

### Why the delete is host-side and guarded

There is **no official session-delete RPC** in this harness generation — the
shipped UI never deletes a session. "Delete this conversation" therefore means
removing the session's own artifact directory under `~/.dsh/sessions/`. That is
irreversible, so the host applies these guards before it removes anything:

1. a **favourited** id is refused outright (checked host-side, not just in the UI);
2. a resolved path **outside the sessions root** is refused;
3. a **symlink** is refused;
4. the sessions root itself is refused;
5. the batch is capped by `maxDeletePerCall`.

Each id is reported separately, so one failure never aborts the batch. After a
successful delete the host emits `api-session/removed` — the harness's own
row-removal event — so the sidebar drops the row immediately instead of showing
it until the next reload.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for the host routes |
| `maxDeletePerCall` | `500` | Hard cap on one delete request |

```yaml
- id: dsh-archive-favorites-forge
  config:
    maxDeletePerCall: 200
```

## Notes and limits

- **The id form**: session ids are spelled `session-<uuid>`, but artifact
  directories on an upgraded machine use **both** `<uuid>` and `session-<uuid>`.
  Every comparison goes through a normaliser and the resolver tries both
  spellings, so this works for old and new conversations alike.
- **Archived conversations cannot be opened** — that is shipped DSH behaviour,
  not this plugin's. Unarchive first if you want to read one.
- **Deleting is permanent.** It removes the conversation and its transcript. It
  does not touch your project working directory.
- **Blank sessions are never candidates.** A "blank" session is the provisional
  New Session slot; it has no content to archive and the shipped sidebar hides
  every blank session except the currently selected one, so a candidate list
  containing one would be impossible to verify. They are excluded from both the
  idle pool and the batch-delete set, and the export names the rest the way the
  sidebar does (`新会话` / `未命名`).
- **Candidate lists are intersected with what the sidebar actually lists.** A
  session that is archived but not rendered (no `cwd`) is never counted or
  acted on.
- The plugin reads the Workspace registry to map a session to its owning
  folder. It mutates that registry only through the registry's **own**
  `archiveSession` / `unarchiveSession` methods, and never writes another
  plugin's internals.

## Development

```
lib/index.js             host half
lib/client.js            client half (a __ModuleLoader__ bundle)
test/probe-client.mjs    DOM-stub + host probe suite
```

Run the suite:

```sh
node test/probe-client.mjs
```

The probe is not a formality — it has repeatedly caught bugs

plugins.description: Mini-games for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: Tetris, Snake, 2048 and Minesweeper in one draggable frosted-glass window, with light/dark themes and per-game leaderboards. · DSH Web 端小游戏合集，毛玻璃悬浮窗、深浅色主题、各游戏独立排行榜。装法：plugin_manager install_bundle。
plugins.readme_text:
# 🎮 dsh-mini-games-lee — DeepSeek Harness 小游戏合集

在 **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI** 上运行的小游戏合集：一个毛玻璃悬浮窗，内含 **7 个游戏**，可随时切换、拖动、收起。

| 游戏 | 玩法 | 排行榜 |
|---|---|---|
| 🕹️ **俄罗斯方块** | 7-bag 出块、墙踢旋转、消行计分、逐级加速、下一块预览 | 分数（高→低） |
| 🐍 **贪吃蛇** | 15×15 网格，吃食物变长、撞墙/自撞结束、每 3 个加速一级 | 分数（高→低） |
| 🔢 **2048** | 4×4 合并到 2048，键盘或屏幕方向键 | 分数（高→低） |
| 💣 **扫雷** | 初级 9×9/10 雷、中级 12×12/24 雷，左键翻开 / 右键标记，首点安全 | 用时（低→高） |
| 🧱 **打砖块** | 300×200 弹球台，7×4 砖墙、挡板控角、逐关加速与奖励分、三条命 | 分数（高→低） |
| 🀄 **五子棋** | 13×13 棋盘，你执黑先手，启发式白棋 AI（会连五也会封四），可悔棋 | 用时（低→高） |
| 🃏 **记忆翻牌** | 5×4 共 10 对，翻错 0.65s 自动盖回 | 用时（低→高） |

共性：
- ☀️/🌙 深浅色主题一键切换，毛玻璃背景
- 窗口可拖到页面任意位置，`▁`/`✕` 收起为标题条（自动暂停），`□` 还原
- **每个游戏独立排行榜**（最近 10 局，localStorage 持久化、可清空）
- 键盘全局操作（打开期间无需点击窗口），同时提供屏幕按钮，输入框打字不受影响

## ✅ 运行环境

| 组件 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（Desktop / Web GUI） | **`0.2.1-rc.2`**（当前安装版，已实测） |
| 前一版 | `0.2.0-rc.2`（同一套 API，仍兼容） |
| 插件形态 | **profile bundle**（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`），经 Plugin Manager 安装 |
| 客户端硬依赖 | `slots`（两个槽位）、`timer`（各游戏时钟）、平台模块 `react` |
| 占用槽位 | `conversation.session.header.utilities`（`list` / `session`）、`shell.overlay`（`list` / `root`） |
| 已不再使用 | `cordis_define` / `cordis_run`（见下） |

> 📌 **0.2.1 的槽位契约**（取自宿主自带的 slot catalog，`cordis_inspect_query` 同源）：
>
> ```
> conversation.session.header.utilities   kind: list   scope: session
>                                         replaceRisk: none
>                                         options: id(required) / order / label
> shell.overlay                           kind: list   scope: root
> ```
>
> 注册形态与该 catalog 的官方示例逐字一致，本包不需要任何迁移代码。

## 🆕 0.6.0：又加了三款

- 🧱 **打砖块**：16ms 固定步长计时器驱动，仍是纯 DOM（不用 canvas / rAF）；挡板按住方向键连续移动，逐关加速与奖励分，三条命耗尽才计分。
- 🀄 **五子棋**：13×13，你执黑先手；白棋 AI 用四方向「连子长度 + 开口数」评分，攻击权重略高于防守（自己的五连优先于封堵），可悔棋；赢棋按用时计榜。
- 🃏 **记忆翻牌**：5×4 共 10 对，翻错 0.65s 自动盖回，通关按用时计榜并记录步数。
- **标签栏从单行 flex 改成 4 列 grid**：7 个游戏在 340px 窗口里排成整齐两行，不再溢出窗口边缘。
- `smoke` / `render-check` 覆盖全部 7 款游戏；`locale` 卡片描述同步为七款。

## 🔄 0.5.0 为 0.2.1 做了什么

对着**已安装**的 0.2.1-rc.2 逐项核对后，结论是：**0.4.0 的运行时用法本来就兼容 0.2.1**，真正过时的是"另一条安装通道"和文档。因此这一版做的是收口与验证，而不是改游戏逻辑：

1. **移除 `cordis_define` 通道**。0.2.1 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis` 只暴露 `cordis_inspect_list` / `cordis_inspect_query`，模型侧已经没有 `cordis_define` / `cordis_run`；`dist/cordis-plugin.js`、`dist/cordis-plugin.code.txt`、`scripts/smoke-cordis.mjs` 一并删除。**bundle 现在是唯一安装路径。**
2. **新增 `scripts/check-host-contract.mjs`**：直接读取已安装的 `app.asar`（自带 asar 解析，不需要 Electron），核对两个槽位的 `kind/scope`、`timer` 服务、平台模块表里的 `react`、以及 `dsh.client.inject` 里每个包是否还在。DSH 升级后跑一次就知道有没有漂。
3. **`npm run smoke` 扩展为清单校验**：`cordis.patch.yml` 的裸包名行、`dsh.client.platform/immediately/inject`、`exports["./client"]`、`locale/*.json` 的 `meta.title/description`、`icon.svg` ≤ 256 KiB。
4. **`package.json` 增加 `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`**：明确标注 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 为 compatible（Plugin Manager 的卡片用它显示兼容性）。
5. **清理**：`lib/` 与 `scripts/build-lib.mjs`（旧的内联归档）、`exports["./payload"]`、`cordis_define` 关键词。
6. **`npm run dev` 预览修正**：替身外壳把 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 的注册显示在侧栏工具条里（真实宿主里它在会话标题栏右上角）。
7. **版本号 0.4.0 → 0.5.0**。

## 🚀 安装

### 推荐：Plugin Manager（Web / Desktop）

在 GUI 里：**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，输入 `github:LeeGuanWei-a/dsh-mini-games-lee`。

或让模型调用：

```
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "github:LeeGuanWei-a/dsh-mini-games-lee" })
```

等价的 CLI（推荐给 `desktop` / `web` profile）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LeeGuanWei-a/dsh-mini-games-lee
```

> ✅ `github:owner/repo`、`https://github.com/owner/repo`、registry 包名、`.tgz` 都可以；它们都会在 `node_modules` 里得到**真实目录副本**。
>
> ❗ **不要用本地路径装**（`target: "F:\\Projects\\dsh-mini-games-lee"`）。那会产出 `link:` 依赖，profile 里的目录是个 junction；Node 会把它解析到真实位置，而本包的裸包名行**在真实位置之上解析不到**，Loader 拿不到 fiber，`install_bundle` 报 `failed to import`。git / registry / tarball 规格才是受支持的安装方式（`@deepseek-ai` 自带的 bundle 也是这么装的）。

安装后 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 会登记本包，`cordis.patch.yml` 插入的那一行由 Loader 挂载，浏览器半区通过包清单里的 `dsh.client` 被发现。

**什么时候生效**：Plugin Manager 在 0.2.1 里会按 profile 是否带 HMR 决定。带 `dsh.profile.patchReload: live` 的 profile 当场重算；当前 `desktop` profile 没开 HMR，所以安装后会得到 `restart-required`，**重启 DeepSeek Harness 后**会话标题栏右上角出现 🎮。

> 📍 **🎮 的位置**：`conversation.session.header.utilities`（会话标题栏右对齐工具条，即页面右上角），`order: 20` 排在自带条目之后——实测紧挨在右侧栏开关左边。
> 这一槽是 **Session 作用域**：空白 Hero 页没有标题栏，也就没有 🎮；但游戏窗口本身在 root 作用域的 `shell.overlay` 里，已经打开的窗口不受影响。
> 没有选隔壁的 `conversation.session.header.corner`：那是 `single` 且已被自带控件占用，注册进去会**顶掉**那个控件。

### 备用：给开发中的源码做本地联调

```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm run dev        # http://127.0.0.1:5188/ 的替身外壳，4 个游戏都能玩
```

## 🧱 两个半区怎么合起来

DSH 的 bundle 是**一个包、两个半区**，两者互不 import：

```
profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles
        │
        ├─ cordis.patch.yml ──► insert 一行
        │                         id:   dsh-mini-games-lee
        │                         name: dsh-mini-games-lee   ← 裸包名，必须是裸包名
        │
        └─ package.json 的 dsh.client
                 platform: "web"                  ← 声明这是 web 客户端插件
                 immediately: true                ← 开机即激活，不等 Session
                 inject: [ui-sidebar, ui-layout]  ← 只影响到达顺序
                 │
                 └─ exports["./client"] ──► dist/client.js  ← 浏览器半区
```

Host 半区 `dist/index.js` 只导出空的 `apply()`：它唯一的职责是让这一行在 Loader 里激活。浏览器半区 `dist/client.js` 才是全部逻辑，以 Client 模块表的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 形式注册。

> **平台模块表（0.2.1 实测）**：壳层冻结的 seed 只有
> `react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`react-dom`、`react-dom/client`、`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`zod`、`@tanstack/react-virtual`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit`。
> 本包只 `require("react")`，所以**不需要** `dsh.client.external`（那个字段只用于非基座请求）。

> ⚠️ **`name` 必须是裸包名 `dsh-mini-games-lee`，不能用相对路径** —— 两件事都靠它：
>
> **① 解析。** bundle patch 插入的行以**bundle 自己的目录**为解析基准，不是 profile。从 `node_modules/dsh-mini-games-lee/` 向上一级就能命中包名。**唯一会失败的情况是 `link:` / 本地路径安装**。所以要用 **git / registry / tarball 规格**安装。
>
> **② 显示元数据。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 `readPluginMeta` 第一行就是 `if (barePackageName(specifier) === void 0) return void 0`。行名写成路径 → **元数据整块放弃**：Plugin Manager 退回把解析后的模块 URL 当作组件名打印，本包的 `icon.svg` 和 `locale/*.json` 里的标题/描述**一个都不会被读**。裸包名是这一切的前置条件。

## 🎮 操作

窗口顶部是一排 **游戏标签**，点击切换（切换会开始新的一局）。

### 🕹️ 俄罗斯方块

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 左右移动 | `←` / `→`，或 ← → |
| 软降（+1/格） | `↓`，或 ▼ |
| 旋转（带墙踢） | `↑` 或 `X`，或 ↻ |
| 反向旋转 | `Z` |
| 硬降（+2/格） | `空格`，或 ⤓ |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `P`，或 Ⅱ |

### 🐍 贪吃蛇

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 转向（反向输入被忽略） | `←` `→` `↑` `↓` 或 `WASD`，或 ↑ ← ↓ → |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `空格` 或 `P`，或 Ⅱ |

### 🔢 2048

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 滑动合并 | `←` `→` `↑` `↓` 或 `WASD`，或 ↑ ← ↓ → |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `P`，或 Ⅱ |

### 💣 扫雷

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 翻开格子（首次点击才布雷，该格及周围保证无雷） | 鼠标左键 |
| 插旗 / 取消插旗 | 鼠标右键 |
| 切换难度（初级 9×9 · 中级 12×12） | 初级 / 中级 |
| 重新开始 | ↺ 新局 |

### 🧱 打砖块

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 左右移动挡板 | 按住 `←` / `→`（或 `A` / `D`），或按住 ‹ › |
| 发球 | `空格`，或 发球 |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `P` 或 `空格`（球已在飞时），或 Ⅱ |
| 重新开始 | ↺ |

### 🀄 五子棋

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 落子（你执黑先手，之后白棋 AI 自动应一手） | 鼠标点击空交叉点 |
| 撤销一整回合（你 + AI 各一手） | 悔棋 |
| 重新开始 | ↺ 新局 |

### 🃏 记忆翻牌

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 翻开一张牌（同时翻开两张后判定，翻错 0.65s 盖回） | 鼠标点击牌面 |
| 重新开始 | ↺ 新局 |

## 📦 仓库结构

```
dsh-mini-games-lee/
├── package.json            # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.compatibility + dsh.client + exports
├── cordis.patch.yml        # 插入 Host 行（name: dsh-mini-games-lee，裸包名）
├── icon.svg                # Plugin Manager 卡片图标（package.json 的 icon 字段）
├── locale/
│   ├── en.json             # 卡片显示元数据：meta.title / meta.description
│   └── zh.json             #   语言文件必须叫语言 id（本宿主内置的只有 zh / en）
├── src/
│   ├── index.js            # Host 半区：空 apply（纯 UI 插件）
│   ├── client.js           # 浏览器半区入口：游戏注册表 + apply
│   ├── shared/
│   │   ├── theme.js        # 深浅色板
│   │   ├── records.js      # 按游戏分库的 localStorage 排行榜
│   │   ├── store.js        # 窗口状态（open/theme/pos/game）
│   │   └── ui.js           # 悬浮窗框架：拖拽、游戏标签、通用排行榜、入口按钮
│   └── games/
│       ├── tetris.js       # 🕹️ 俄罗斯方块
│       ├── snake.js        # 🐍 贪吃蛇
│       ├── g2048.js        # 🔢 2048
│       ├── minesweeper.js  # 💣 扫雷
